title: Policy-Selected Transaction Tapes in Automated Market Makers: Ranking Certification under Hidden Opportunities
abstract: arXiv:2609.19013v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Programmable matching mechanisms decide which orders become data. A loss metric computed from a mechanism's own transaction tape therefore mixes execution quality with selection. We study when loss-per-service rankings from policy-selected marked transaction tapes can be sign-certified under hidden-opportunity and sampling uncertainty. The tape identifies a selected compensator, $e^{\pi_0}\nu^\circ$, plus martingale fluctuation; it does not identify hidden opportunity composition. We give an exact native two-tape non-identification construction, sharp signed hidden-mass ranking regions, and projection-based confidence sets that certify a sign or abstain with a region-wise denominator screen. In a two-year WETH--USDC application, point estimates order pools but the descriptive cross-pool ranking is not sign-certified. The reported comparison is a selected-tape ranking, not a dynamic mechanism counterfactual.

translated_title: 自动做市商中策略选择的交易带：隐藏机会下的排名认证
translated_abstract: 可编程撮合机制决定了哪些订单会成为数据。因此，从机制自身的交易带计算出的损失指标将执行质量与选择效应混在了一起。我们研究了在隐藏机会与抽样不确定性下，由策略选择的标记交易带得出的单位服务损失排名何时可以进行符号认证。交易带只能识别出一个被选补偿子 $e^{\pi_0}\nu^\circ$ 加上鞅波动，而无法识别隐藏机会的构成。我们给出了一个精确的固有两交易带不可识别构造、尖锐的带符号隐藏质量排名区域，以及基于投影的置信集——后者通过区域分母筛选来认证排名符号或选择弃权。在一个为期两年的WETH–USDC应用中，点估计能够对资金池进行排序，但描述性的跨资金池排名未能获得符号认证。所报告的比较是基于所选交易带的排名，而非动态机制的反事实分析。
tldr: 该论文针对自动做市商中交易带由策略选择导致的度量偏差问题，提出了认证单位服务损失排名符号的方法——包括两交易带不可识别构造、带符号隐藏质量排名区域和可弃权的投影置信集，并在WETH-USDC数据上发现跨资金池排名无法通过符号认证。
en_tdlr: This paper develops sign-certification methods for loss-per-service rankings from policy-selected transaction tapes in automated market makers—including a two-tape non-identification construction, sharp signed hidden-mass ranking regions, and abstaining projection confidence sets—showing that cross-pool rankings cannot be sign-certified in a WETH-USDC application.
